home_lede: Deep Cities is a wiki of maps made by people who actually know the place: odd museums, hidden courtyards, the bar with the story. Suggest a spot, moderators check it, and everyone gets a better map.
home_how_propose_body: Sign in with your email, drop a pin and tell us why it's worth a detour. Photos and links welcome.
home_how_review_body: Every new place and every edit is reviewed by the map's moderators before it goes live. Nothing is lost: each change becomes part of the place's history.
home_how_rate_body: Been there? Leave a star rating so the best of the C-list rises to the top.
auth_subtitle: We'll email you a one-time sign-in link.
auth_no_password: No password needed. New here? The link creates your account.
auth_check_body: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
auth_dev_note: Local dev: no email is sent. Use the link directly:
me_name_hint: Shown next to your suggestions and edits.
map_empty: No places yet. Be the first to suggest one!
rating_sign_in: Sign in to rate this place
rating_not_allowed: Only contributors can rate places on this map.
place_archived: This place was removed from the map. It's kept here for the record.
place_removal_desc: Closed for good, wrong location, not really a hidden gem? Tell the moderators.
place_you_have_pending_one: You have a suggestion for this place waiting for review.
place_you_have_pending_other: You have {{count}} suggestions for this place waiting for review.
new_intro: Something locals love that tourists walk right past? Tap the map to drop a pin, then tell us about it.
new_sign_in: Sign in to suggest a place
new_not_allowed: This map only accepts suggestions from invited contributors.
edit_intro: Your changes are sent to the moderators. You can drag the pin to fix the location.
edit_intro_mod: As a moderator, your changes publish immediately and are recorded in the history.
form_location_pick: Tap the map to place a pin
form_location_hint: You can drag the pin afterwards to fine-tune it.
form_location_adjust: drag the pin or tap the map to move it
form_summary: In one or two sentences: why go?
form_body_hint: Tips, history, opening quirks. Supports **bold**, *italic*, and "-" lists.
form_note_hint: Where did you hear about it? Anything they should check?
form_note_hint_mod: Optional. Shown in the place's history.
form_sent_for_review: Thanks! Sent to the moderators for review.
form_error_location: Tap the map to set the location.
form_error_links: Each link needs a label and a full http(s) URL.
review_subtitle: Approve to publish, or reject with a short note for the contributor.
review_mine_subtitle: Everything you've suggested on this map, and what the moderators said.
review_mine_empty: You haven't suggested anything on this map yet.
review_stale: The place changed after this edit was suggested. Approving replaces the newer version.
review_archive_explainer: Remove "{{title}}" from the map. It stays visible in the history.
manage_subtitle: People and settings for this map.
manage_forbidden: Only this map's admins can manage it.
manage_members_desc_open: Anyone signed in can suggest places. Moderators review suggestions; admins also manage people and settings. Ban someone to stop their suggestions.
manage_members_desc_members: Only the people listed here can suggest places. Moderators review suggestions; admins also manage people and settings.
manage_member_hint: The person must have signed in to Deep Cities at least once. Only the site owner can appoint admins.
admin_subtitle: Create maps and manage site-wide roles.
admin_forbidden: Only the site owner can see this page.
admin_create_map_desc: You'll be taken to its settings to add people and a description.
tokens_hint: For the dc command-line tool and scripts. A token acts as you, with your permissions.
tokens_copy_now: Copy this token now. It won't be shown again.
manage_fields_hint: Extra fields every place on this map can have, on top of the standard ones. The key in grey is how the value is stored (and what the CLI uses); it can't be changed. Fields can't be deleted: hide one to take it off the form and place pages while keeping its values.
routes_intro: Walks and rides that link places on this map.
route_archived: This route has been removed from the map. You're seeing its last version.
route_stop_removed: This place has since been removed from the map.
route_time_note: Times are moving time only, at an easy pace. Add time for looking around.
route_removal_desc: Tell the moderators why. The route stays in the history.
route_new_intro: String places on this map into a walk or ride. Add stops, then shape the path between them.
route_edit_intro_mod: Your changes publish immediately and are recorded in the route's history.
route_form_title_placeholder: A 2-hour walk past the post-war schools
route_form_stops_hint: In order. Each stop can have its own narration; between stops, set how you travel and give directions.
route_form_find_place: Add a place from this map…
route_form_click_places: Or tap place markers on the map to add them as stops.
route_form_point_nudge: Stop isn't on the map? Better to add it as a place first so others can find it. If it really isn't worth a place (a viewpoint, a corner),
route_form_point_click: Tap the map where the custom point should go.
route_form_point_hint: Custom point: drag its pin on the map to move it.
route_form_adhoc_note: Routes with custom points are fine, but places make the map richer. Consider suggesting them as places.
route_form_narration_placeholder: What to look at here, in the context of this route (optional, markdown)
route_form_path_hint: Tap the map to add waypoints the path must pass through. Drag them to adjust, tap one to remove it.
route_form_snap_failed: Couldn't follow streets ({{message}}); showing straight lines.
route_form_directions_placeholder: How to get to the next stop (optional)
route_form_error_title: Give the route a title (2–100 characters).
route_form_error_stops: A route needs at least 2 stops (max 30), each with a name.
route_form_error_legs: Something is wrong with the path between stops; try reshaping it.
route_form_via_title: Waypoint: drag to move, tap to remove
review_route_archive_explainer: Remove the route “{{title}}” from the map. It stays in the history.
route_edit_intro: Your changes are sent to the moderators.
content_untranslated: Not translated into {{lang}} yet, so this is shown in {{base}}.
content_partly_untranslated: Parts of this aren’t translated into {{lang}} yet and are shown in {{base}}.
content_lang_translating_hint: You’re translating: only texts are shown. Everything else is shared by all languages; switch to {{base}} to change it. Leave a field empty to show the {{base}} text.
manage_languages_desc: The language this map’s content is written in, and the languages readers can switch places, routes and map texts to. This is separate from the language of the site’s interface.
manage_lang_base_hint: The original language of places and routes. Anything not translated is shown in this language.
manage_lang_extra_hint: Readers can pick these on the map. Contributors can then add translations to places and routes.
doc_archived: This document was archived. Only moderators can see it.
doc_new_desc: Background reading for this map: an essay, a biography, a guide. Attach it to the map, to places, or both.
doc_not_allowed: Only moderators and admins of this map can write documents.
doc_body_help: Markdown: # headings, **bold**, *italic*, - lists, > quotes, [links](https://…), [a place](place:ID). Pictures go on their own line: ![caption](photo:ID).
doc_pictures_help: The first picture not used in the text is the cover; others not used in the text form a gallery. Click a thumbnail below to insert it into the text.
doc_insert_picture: Insert into the text at the cursor
doc_archive_desc: It disappears from the map and its places but stays in the history. Say why.
routes_no_matches: No routes of this kind yet.
route_form_mode_help: What the route is. Each leg can still use other transport, like a ferry crossing.
route_form_loop: It's a loop: it ends where it starts
route_form_loop_help: Ticked for you when the last stop is the first one.
